observations: Step 6 new-package check: the requirement for a new package is three or more concepts connected by explicit bechina language in the source text that form an independent domain not covered by existing packages. LM2 Torah #123 does not meet this threshold. The text contains no bechina declarations at all — the word 'בְּחִינַת' does not appear. The teaching's concepts (mikveh immersion, sweat pores, bodily health, water temperature, ascetic practices, pride) are related exclusively by eitza chains: mikveh → opens sweat pores → good health; cold water → closes sweat pores; pride → harm from ascetic practices. These causal chains cannot generate packages, which by definition must be built from bechina (parallel-nature) edges. No new packages are proposed.
